name: r4-q4-skip-blob-tz
description: Fix Q4 (review A2 B2): runHousekeeping resets SKIP_TODAY with P.localParts(now, s.zone_timezone || gatewayTimezone || 'UTC'). A BLOB zone timezone is a truthy Buffer even when empty; Intl refuses '' (and invalid UTF-8), so the valve's 'today' is the UTC day. West phase, gateway Etc/GMT+12: F1 (X'', skip anchor-1) resets on Node-RED at every hour; a backend that falls through to the gateway keeps it while UTC is before 12:00. East phase, gateway Pacific/Kiritimati: E1 (X'', skip anchor+0) and E4 (X'C3FF') never reset on Node-RED; a gateway-day backend resets them from 10:00 UTC. Between them the two phases split such a backend at every hour. Controls: F2/E2 empty TEXT (gateway day, dates two days out), F3/E3 BLOB 'Asia/Tokyo' (decoded, Tokyo day), F4/F6 0 and 0.0 (TEXT affinity stores '0' and '0.0', truthy, Intl refuses them), F5 blank TEXT.
